Sample.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/6] Participants assigned to the four conditions did not differ on demographic factors, treatment services received for emotional/behavior problems during the past year, or baseline versions of the outcomes, with the exception of baseline depressive symptoms (F [3,334] = 4.80; p = . 003; η 2 = .04) (Table 1 reports means for outcomes across conditions and assessments).

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/7] Attendance was similar across groups, 44% of CB participants attended all 6 sessions compared to 45% of supportive-expressive participants; 86% percent of CB participants and 89% of supportive-expressive participants attended at least 3 of the 6 sessions.
